title: Add unit tests for an untested function

params.name: file
params.description: The source file that contains the function.

preconditions: A test script (scripts.test) and a test runner.
The named file exists and contains the named function.

criteria.pass: New or changed test files reference the function, the test script passes, and no non-test files changed.
criteria.partial: Tests were added and pass, but non-test files changed, test files were deleted, or no test references the function.
criteria.fail: No test files were added or changed, or the test script fails.
